card.name: Words signaling combined use with another drug
card.fires_on: Words that point to a drug being given together with another, such as the end of concomitantly, the comma or word after drug-drug in interaction lists, and coformulated or coadministration terms.

modes.label: Drug-drug interaction list
modes.description: The word or comma inside a list of interaction types like drug-drug, drug-food, drug-herb.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Overview: No formal drug-drug,<< drug>>-food, or drug-herb interaction

modes.label: Concomitantly ending
modes.description: The final piece of concomitantly, said of use alongside another medicine.
modes.example: Patients usually do not require doses in excess of 50 mg of hydrochlorothiazide daily when used concomit<<antly>> with other antihypertensive agents

modes.label: Coadministration terms
modes.description: Partway through words like coformulated or coadministration of NSAIDs.
